root_cause.text: In the GRE ERSPAN receive functions, the `options_len` field of `struct ip_tunnel_info` was not initialized before accessing the `options` flexible array member, violating the `counted_by` attribute constraint required by FORTIFY_SOURCE.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff moves `info->options_len = sizeof(*md);` to execute before the `memcpy` that writes to `options` in `net/ipv4/ip_gre.c` and `net/ipv6/ip6_gre.c`, fixing the "buffer size 0" panic reported in the CVE description.
